what: Case (e) drops assert_equal_stdout for a three-needle assert_contains/not_contains block that does not pin invariant #8 (exactly two stdout lines) or a byte-exact ERROR= line
scenario_or_breakage: After the fixed-token change, a regression that emits a third KV line (e.g. ISSUE_NUMBER=123) or appends attacker-controlled text on the ERROR= line after the fixed token would still pass as long as FAILED=true, the fixed-token substring, and assert_not_contains yes all succeed; the current assert_equal_stdout at line 179 rejects any extra/missing line or ERROR drift
suggested_fix: Prefer assert_equal_stdout with the new exact two-line envelope (as cases (i)/(o) still do), or add an explicit two-line / full-envelope assertion; keep assert_not_contains for yes or ADOPTED=yes as a belt-and-suspenders guard
